testcase.name: Scenario: Reflow an expanded panel when an adjacent panel is hidden: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/panel-visibility-snapshot/checkout/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:523:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reflow an expanded panel when an adjacent panel is hidden ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon docked at the top ✔ And the Create and Modify panels are visible, with Create before Modify ✔ And the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned ✔ When the user opens the panel selector and clears Create ✔ Then Create is unchecked and its panel is hidden ✔ And the Modify panel shifts left while its additional commands remain open ✔ And the panel selector remains open ✔ When the user selects Create in the panel selector ✔ Then Create is checked and returns before Modify ✔ And the Modify panel and its open additional commands return to their earlier position ✔ And the panel selector remains open
